After the breakup with his girlfriend, he felt powerless and valueless. He started opening up his mind throughout meeting so-called rental-girlfriends and seeking what he can do to others. With his hardworking and gentle mind, these girls began to feel that he might be a guy who would love them and make their lives delightful forever. I was so motivated by his pure love for her. I felt grateful for his effort, and his values are being recognized gradually. This manga encourages people that hardworking and passionate can achieve bigger goals.

うらやすてっきんかぞく
animeItems.description:
This is one of the traditional Japanese comedy comics that people around my age or older growing up reading when young. Oosawagi (means very noisy) family is the main ones and this comic depicts the ordinary life of them and Kotetsu (main character from the family) and his school friends. The quality of the story is not as good but it sometimes makes me laugh. The style of drawing is quite different between the first season (Super Radical Gag Family) and second season (Original! Super Radical Gag Family). The first one is drawn in very old way and more of old comedy where some strange characters appear do strange stuff. The second season focused on more of main character building and the design of the characters much improved. But first season was funnier. You may like it if you are looking for simple jokes. It is funny for elementary kids.

どらえもん
ごとうぶんのはなよめ
animeItems.description:
The story starts with the main character guy: Futaro trace back his memory of meeting quintuplets in his school. His family was poor, and he was assigned a job to teach wealthy students from the same school, which turned out to be quintuplets: Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba, and Itsuki. He thought it was an easy job as he being a top student. However, he was rejected a lot by them despite the many trials.

These girls started to acknowledge how much they have improved even though their score was low, starting to appreciate Futaro's passion and willingness to improve their score. He gradually became attractive to the quintuplets. As he had no taste in romance, he sometimes hurt them by not knowing how to treat friends properly, but his pure and innocent words and actions move their hearts, resulting in opening up their minds.

While Futaro was chasing the quintuplets for studying, the quintuplets started to chase him more, with each girl in her own way. As the quintuplets grew up together with very close looking, they hoped to be together forever and want to think, feel, and act the same way. But the more time they spend with Futaro, they gradually found that they have completely different hobbies, ideas, and mentality. As they grow the individual characteristic and independence, they started to fear that the solid quintessential bond would disappear. After the quarrel between Nino and Itsuki, Nino left the house, and the relationship became messy.

Even though Futaro was not responsible for anything except bringing up their score, he made lots of effort to unite the quintuplets back. His endless effort came true, and they became one team, including Futaro, at the end. Thanks to that, quintuplets gained the courage to be independent and being different. Their decision made them be apart from their dad, who always wants them to follow his way, ending up leaving his gorgeous house and back to poor life in a small room in an old building.

Because of the decision, they couldn't pay Futaro, but he insisted on supporting them until they find their passion besides improving the score. Even though the quintuplets caused some issues and nuisance, Futaro never gave up being a top student and supporting them even though his family was poor. Because of that, each girl started to develop stronger feelings towards him, resulting in more battles within the quintuplets.
As these girls try to approach him, he also started to have feelings for them as well. Then the critical story of Futaro starts to play a role: the memory of meeting a girl in school traveling to Kyoto who made Futaro such a hardworking guy out of an outraged little boy. The girl turned out to be one among the quintuplets, and he started seeking who that was, which forces him to learn about the quintuples, like how they are different from each other besides the appearance. This made the romance battle more dramatic and exciting.

To find out whether Futaro really understands the quintuplets or not, they played the "quintuplets game" to him: they dress up as Ituki and fool Futaro. He wasn't able to tell one from the other initially, but he never gave up knowing about them; he finally recognized individuals, which made the quintuplets very happy and really willing to be his girlfriend.
As their approach toward him becomes more aggressive, each tries to deceive others and make him own, which caused lots of conflicts again, but in the end, they reconcile again by respect each other and try to be "fair rather than equal." At the end of this love game, he finally picks one among them who he disclosed his favor from the beginning of his tutoring. He ended up marrying her.

I enjoyed how his passionate and innocent actions influenced the quintuplets' minds and changed their lives in a good way. He not only taught about studying but also find their passion and what they are skillful at. As Futaro helps them, he also grew up a lot by also getting out of his box. It is very satisfying to see the characters' growth besides the romance battle. Also, I liked the process that Futaro and the quintuplets gradually get to know each other and care about each other while they were conflicted at the beginning.

People usually enjoy guessing who would be Futaro's fiance and who they like the most. I have heard a lot of discussions and who is better than others. I picked Yotsuba among the quintuplets, as I liked how much she cares about others and making her friends happy. There is a scene that she looks so excited to see Futaro smiling. This is convincing that she is the one who could enjoy other's happiness instead of being materialistic, so I liked her the better.

animeItems.description:
One can be so unmotivated and servile when the world works against his/her will. The manga depicts an ordinary life of a high school student who was left alone but confident in his beliefs and personality. His teacher Shizuka who has unique justice, put him into a volunteer club to save him. There, he encounters Yukino, gifted with both brains and beauty but very sarcastic. Yui, who is very charming but always hesitant, also joined the club. They were gathered to the club as they had own issue and would tackle their life challenges throughout resolving the requests comes into the club. They were put into various demands and always able to resolve them, but with one flaw. Hachiman always sacrifices himself to save others, which he got used to. While Yukino and Yui were making fun of him, they started to feel frustrated as they built a friendship.
They started to seek a genuine friendship, and that is very complicated...
There is more stuff to write about.. so I will update this later.
